div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Read-only by design.
Passive listener on both buses (SPAN/mirror);
never publishes GOOSE, never commands MMS,
never trips a breaker. Surfaces evidence to the SME.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Seal contract gates GPU power.
SEALED ⇄ AWAITING_SME ⇄ INVESTIGATION is the
SME flow. GPU unpowered in SEALED.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
One time domain.
The substation PTP grandmaster disciplines both
buses AND the edge compute's signal-plane clock
(origin_ns sealed at ingest).

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Physical-security feeds are read-only too —
capture + correlate, never command. Camera + PD
cross-correlation is a target Stage 7e+ use case.
